title: LemGendized AI Helper Assistant
subtitle: AI Assistant for Dataset Engineering, Training, and Safe Troubleshooting
description:
## Dataset Overview

- **Category:** Technical Documentation & AI Assistant Training
- **Total Samples:** 80 (52 train / 28 val)
- **Format:** JSONL supervised dialogue (`messages`: `system`, `user`, `assistant`)
- **Architecture Base:** Transformer-Based Causal Language Model (Fine-Tuned Instruction Head)
- **Primary Task:** Answer architectural, operational, and diagnostic inquiries across the LemGendary ecosystem.

collectionMethodology: Curated supervised instruction examples derived from reviewed documentation and general AI/ML engineering principles. Each example is designed around a user task, diagnostic decision, terminology distinction, or documentation authority rule. Records use one JSON object per line with messages in system/user/assistant order. Validated for zero semantic leakage, schema integrity, and held-out evaluation performance.
